{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(data))
print("Unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
duplicate_count = len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
missing_baseline_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline_count}")

# Show the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
duplicates = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]
duplicate_summary = duplicates.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()
print("Max sample_seq per patient_id (for duplicates):\n", duplicate_summary)"}
